name: @ham2k/lib-gma-spots
description: Posting spots to cqgma.org, shared by the award programs that use its infrastructure
author: Sebastian Delmont <sd@ham2k.com>
//exports: Consumed as TypeScript source: the only consumers are extensions, which
esbuild bundles, so there is no build step and no dist/ to point at.
//peerDependencies: Both are the consuming extension's to provide: its bundle carries one copy
of the SDK and declares lib-callsigns in its manifest, and the build
rewrites that import to the host's instance.
